```{r classify}
# ---- GPT classification function ----
classify_urban_relevance <- function(text, api_key, model, max_tokens) {

  prompt <- paste0(
    "You are an expert in urban climate adaptation research.\n\n",
    "Your task is to classify the following text according to which urban concepts it references.\n\n",
    "For each of the following urban categories, state whether it is referenced (Yes/No) in the text.\n",
    "Consider all word variants and plurals for each category:\n\n",
    "1. Urban (keywords: urban, urbanisation, urbanization)\n",
    "2. City/Cities (keywords: city, cities)\n",
    "3. Municipality/Municipal (keywords: municipality, municipal, municipalities)\n",
    "4. Metropolitan/Metro (keywords: metropolitan, metro)\n",
    "5. Peri-urban (keywords: peri-urban, periurban)\n",
    "6. Informal settlement (keywords: informal settlement, informal settlements)\n",
    "7. Slum (keywords: slum, slums, slum-dwellers, slum-dwelling, slum-based)\n",
    "8. Township (keywords: township, townships)\n",
    "9. Town (keywords: town, towns)\n",
    "10. Built environment (keywords: built environment)\n",
    "11. Human settlement (keywords: human settlement, human settlements)\n\n",
    "Text:\n\"", text, "\"\n\n",
    "Respond ONLY with a JSON object in this exact format (no additional text):\n",
    "{\n",
    "  \"urban_relevant\": \"Yes\" or \"No\",\n",
    "  \"urban\": \"Yes\" or \"No\",\n",
    "  \"city_cities\": \"Yes\" or \"No\",\n",
    "  \"municipality_municipal\": \"Yes\" or \"No\",\n",
    "  \"metropolitan_metro\": \"Yes\" or \"No\",\n",
    "  \"peri_urban\": \"Yes\" or \"No\",\n",
    "  \"informal_settlement\": \"Yes\" or \"No\",\n",
    "  \"slum\": \"Yes\" or \"No\",\n",
    "  \"township\": \"Yes\" or \"No\",\n",
    "  \"town\": \"Yes\" or \"No\",\n",
    "  \"built_environment\": \"Yes\" or \"No\",\n",
    "  \"human_settlement\": \"Yes\" or \"No\",\n",
    "  \"reasoning\": \"one sentence explanation\"\n",
    "}"
  )

  response <- tryCatch({
    POST(
      url = "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions",
      add_headers(
        Authorization = paste("Bearer", api_key),
        `Content-Type` = "application/json"
      ),
      body = toJSON(list(
        model                 = model,
        max_completion_tokens = max_tokens,
        messages              = list(
          list(role = "user", content = prompt)
        )
      ), auto_unbox = TRUE),
      encode = "json"
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("API call failed: ", e$message)
    return(NULL)
  })

  if (is.null(response)) {
    return(list(urban_relevant = "Error", urban = NA, city_cities = NA,
                municipality_municipal = NA, metropolitan_metro = NA,
                peri_urban = NA, informal_settlement = NA, slum = NA,
                township = NA, town = NA, built_environment = NA,
                human_settlement = NA, reasoning = "API call failed"))
  }

  cnt <- content(response, as = "parsed", encoding = "UTF-8")

  if (!is.null(cnt$error)) {
    return(list(urban_relevant = "Error", urban = NA, city_cities = NA,
                municipality_municipal = NA, metropolitan_metro = NA,
                peri_urban = NA, informal_settlement = NA, slum = NA,
                township = NA, town = NA, built_environment = NA,
                human_settlement = NA, reasoning = cnt$error$message))
  }

  raw_text <- cnt$choices[[1]]$message$content

  result <- tryCatch({
    clean_text <- gsub("```json|```", "", raw_text)
    clean_text <- str_trim(clean_text)
    fromJSON(clean_text)
  }, error = function(e) {
    list(urban_relevant = "Parse Error", urban = NA, city_cities = NA,
         municipality_municipal = NA, metropolitan_metro = NA,
         peri_urban = NA, informal_settlement = NA, slum = NA,
         township = NA, town = NA, built_environment = NA,
         human_settlement = NA, reasoning = raw_text)
  })

  return(result)
}

# ---- Run classification ----
total_rows  <- nrow(adaptdata)
error_count <- 0
results     <- vector("list", total_rows)

cat("Starting classification of", total_rows, "rows...\n\n")

for (i in seq_len(total_rows)) {

  text   <- adaptdata$ElementText[i]
  result <- classify_urban_relevance(
    text       = text,
    api_key    = OPENAI_API_KEY,
    model      = GPT_MODEL,
    max_tokens = MAX_TOKENS
  )

  if (!is.null(result$urban_relevant) &&
      result$urban_relevant %in% c("Error", "Parse Error")) {
    error_count <- error_count + 1
  }

  results[[i]] <- list(
    urban_relevant         = if (!is.null(result$urban_relevant))         result$urban_relevant         else NA,
    urban                  = if (!is.null(result$urban))                  result$urban                  else NA,
    city_cities            = if (!is.null(result$city_cities))            result$city_cities            else NA,
    municipality_municipal = if (!is.null(result$municipality_municipal)) result$municipality_municipal else NA,
    metropolitan_metro     = if (!is.null(result$metropolitan_metro))     result$metropolitan_metro     else NA,
    peri_urban             = if (!is.null(result$peri_urban))             result$peri_urban             else NA,
    informal_settlement    = if (!is.null(result$informal_settlement))    result$informal_settlement    else NA,
    slum                   = if (!is.null(result$slum))                   result$slum                   else NA,
    township               = if (!is.null(result$township))               result$township               else NA,
    town                   = if (!is.null(result$town))                   result$town                   else NA,
    built_environment      = if (!is.null(result$built_environment))      result$built_environment      else NA,
    human_settlement       = if (!is.null(result$human_settlement))       result$human_settlement       else NA,
    reasoning              = if (!is.null(result$reasoning))              result$reasoning              else NA
  )

  # Progress update every 10 rows
  if (i %% 10 == 0 || i == 1) {
    cat(sprintf("  Row %d / %d (%.0f%%) | Errors: %d\n",
                i, total_rows, (i / total_rows) * 100, error_count))
    flush.console()
  }

  Sys.sleep(0.2)
}

# ---- Bind results ----
results_df            <- bind_rows(lapply(results, as.data.frame, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
adaptdata_classified <- bind_cols(adaptdata, results_df) %>%
  mutate(needs_review = urban_relevant %in% c("Error", "Parse Error"))

cat("\n\nClassification complete!\n")
cat("Urban Relevant - Yes:", sum(adaptdata_classified$urban_relevant == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Urban Relevant - No: ", sum(adaptdata_classified$urban_relevant == "No",  na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Errors:              ", sum(adaptdata_classified$needs_review,             na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
```

# ---- API Setup ----
OPENAI_API_KEY <- Sys.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
stopifnot(nzchar(OPENAI_API_KEY))
GPT_MODEL  <- "gpt-4o-mini"
MAX_TOKENS <- 2000

# ---- Read data ----
urban_data_classified <- read_excel("data/urban_relevance_classified.xlsx")

# ---- Filter ----
result_data <- urban_data_classified %>%
  filter(urban_relevant == "Yes") %>%
  filter(Element == "Result") %>%
  filter(!is.na(ElementText) & str_trim(ElementText) != "" & ElementText != "NA")

cat("Rows to classify:", nrow(result_data), "\n")

classify_benefits <- function(text, api_key, model, max_tokens) {
  
  # Sanitize input
  text <- gsub('"', "'", text)
  text <- gsub("\\\\", " ", text)
  
  prompt <- paste0(
    "You are an expert in climate adaptation research.\n\n",
    "Read the following text and extract:\n\n",
    "1. BENEFICIARIES: Who or what benefits? List ALL.\n",
    "2. BENEFIT TYPES: What types of benefits? List ALL.\n",
    "3. SCALE: Choose ALL that apply: Individual, Household, Community, City, National, Regional, Global\n\n",
    "Text:\n\"", text, "\"\n\n",
    "Respond ONLY with this exact JSON format, no other text:\n",
    "{\"beneficiaries\": [\"value1\", \"value2\"], \"benefit_types\": [\"value1\", \"value2\"], \"scales\": [\"value1\"]}"
  )

  response <- tryCatch({
    POST(
      url = "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions",
      add_headers(Authorization = paste("Bearer", api_key),
                  `Content-Type` = "application/json"),
      body = toJSON(list(
        model                 = model,
        max_completion_tokens = max_tokens,
        messages              = list(list(role = "user", content = prompt))
      ), auto_unbox = TRUE),
      encode = "json"
    )
  }, error = function(e) NULL)

  if (is.null(response)) {
    return(list(beneficiaries = NA, benefit_types = NA, scales = NA))
  }

  cnt <- content(response, as = "parsed", encoding = "UTF-8")

  if (!is.null(cnt$error)) {
    return(list(beneficiaries = NA, benefit_types = NA, scales = NA))
  }

  raw_text <- cnt$choices[[1]]$message$content

  result <- tryCatch({
    clean_text <- gsub("```json|```", "", raw_text)
    clean_text <- str_trim(clean_text)
    clean_text <- gsub("\\n", " ", clean_text)
    clean_text <- gsub("\\s{2,}", " ", clean_text)
    fromJSON(clean_text)
  }, error = function(e) {
    list(beneficiaries = NA, benefit_types = NA, scales = NA)
  })

  return(result)
}

# ---- Test ----
test <- classify_benefits(result_data$ElementText[1], OPENAI_API_KEY, GPT_MODEL, MAX_TOKENS)
print(test)


# ---- Run classification ----
total_rows  <- nrow(result_data)
error_count <- 0
results     <- vector("list", total_rows)

cat("Starting benefit classification of", total_rows, "rows...\n\n")

for (i in seq_len(total_rows)) {

  text   <- result_data$ElementText[i]
  result <- classify_benefits(
    text       = text,
    api_key    = OPENAI_API_KEY,
    model      = GPT_MODEL,
    max_tokens = MAX_TOKENS
  )

  results[[i]] <- list(
    beneficiaries = if (!is.null(result$beneficiaries) && !all(is.na(result$beneficiaries)))
                      paste(unlist(result$beneficiaries), collapse = "; ") else NA,
    benefit_types = if (!is.null(result$benefit_types) && !all(is.na(result$benefit_types)))
                      paste(unlist(result$benefit_types), collapse = "; ") else NA,
    scales        = if (!is.null(result$scales) && !all(is.na(result$scales)))
                      paste(unlist(result$scales), collapse = "; ") else NA
  )

  if (is.na(results[[i]]$beneficiaries)) error_count <- error_count + 1

  if (i %% 10 == 0 || i == 1) {
    cat(sprintf("  Row %d / %d (%.0f%%) | Errors: %d\n",
                i, total_rows, (i / total_rows) * 100, error_count))
    flush.console()
  }

  if (i %% 100 == 0) {
    temp_df  <- bind_rows(lapply(results[1:i], as.data.frame, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    temp_out <- bind_cols(result_data[1:i, ], temp_df)
    write_xlsx(temp_out, path = "data/benefits_TEMP.xlsx")
    cat("  [checkpoint saved at row", i, "]\n")
  }

  Sys.sleep(0.2)
}

results_df    <- bind_rows(lapply(results, as.data.frame, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
results_final <- bind_cols(result_data, results_df)

write_xlsx(results_final, path = "data/benefits_classified.xlsx")
cat("\nDone!\n")
cat("Total rows:", nrow(results_final), "\n")
cat("Errors:    ", error_count, "\n")

# ---- Colour palette (matching your style) ----
my_colours <- c(
  "#C8393B", "#E8A838", "#F0C93A", "#4DA04A", "#2E7D4F",
  "#5BB5D5", "#2A5DA8", "#8B4DA0", "#D4736A", "#7BAF3E",

# ---- Helper: donut plot function ----
make_donut <- function(data, col, title, top_n = NULL) {
  
  df <- data %>%
    count(.data[[col]], name = "n") %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[col]]) & .data[[col]] != "NA") %>%
    arrange(desc(n))
  
  if (!is.null(top_n)) {
    df <- df %>%
      slice(1:top_n) %>%
      mutate(!!col := str_wrap(.data[[col]], 20))
  }
  
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      pct   = n / sum(n),
      label = paste0(round(pct * 100), "%")
    )
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = 2, y = pct, fill = .data[[col]])) +
    geom_col(width = 1, color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
    coord_polar(theta = "y") +
    xlim(0.5, 2.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = my_colours[1:nrow(df)]) +
    geom_text(aes(label = label),
              position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
              color = "white", size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
    labs(title = title, fill = NULL) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 13, margin = margin(b = 10)),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.text     = element_text(size = 9)
    )
}

    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid      = element_blank()

    BeneficiaryGroup_Tagg = str_trim(BeneficiaryGroup_Tagg)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    BenefitType_Tagg      != "" & BenefitType_Tagg      != "NA" & BenefitType_Tagg      != "Not applicable",
    BeneficiaryGroup_Tagg != "" & BeneficiaryGroup_Tagg != "NA" & BeneficiaryGroup_Tagg != "Not applicable"
  ) %>%
  count(BeneficiaryGroup_Tagg, BenefitType_Tagg, name = "value")

# ---- Plot ----
p_sankey <- ggplot(
  sankey_df,
  aes(axis1 = BeneficiaryGroup_Tagg, axis2 = BenefitType_Tagg, y = value)
) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = BeneficiaryGroup_Tagg), width = 0.25, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_stratum(width = 0.25, fill = "grey95", color = "grey40") +
  geom_text(
    stat = "stratum",
    aes(label = after_stat(stratum)),
    size = 3.5,
    lineheight = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = c("Beneficiary Group", "Benefit Type"),
    expand = c(0.1, 0.1)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "#C8393B", "#E8A838", "#F0C93A", "#4DA04A", "#2E7D4F",
    "#5BB5D5", "#2A5DA8", "#8B4DA0", "#D4736A", "#7BAF3E",
    "#E8724A", "#A0C4D8", "#6B8E6B", "#C4A882", "#8B6E4A"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Beneficiary Groups and Benefit Types",
    x     = NULL,
    y     = "Number of data points",
    fill  = "Beneficiary Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid      = element_blank()
  )

print(p_sankey)
ggsave("figures/sankey_cdp_benefits.png", p_sankey, width = 11, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# Total in sankey_df_cdp
cat("Total flows in CDP Sankey:", sum(sankey_df_cdp$value), "\n")

# Total in BTR sankey
cat("Total flows in BTR Sankey:", sum(sankey_df$value), "\n")

# Original rows in CDP (excluding not applicable)
cdp_included <- benefits_cdp %>%
  filter(!is.na(BenefitType_Tagg) & BenefitType_Tagg != "NA" &
         !is.na(BeneficiaryGroup_Tagg) & BeneficiaryGroup_Tagg != "NA" &
         BenefitType_Tagg != "Not applicable" & 
         BeneficiaryGroup_Tagg != "Not applicable") %>%
  nrow()

cat("CDP rows included (before splitting):", cdp_included, "\n")
cat("CDP Not applicable excluded:", 656, "\n")
cat("CDP total check:", cdp_included + 656, "\n")

# Total flows in BTR Sankey
cat("Total flows in BTR Sankey:", sum(sankey_df$value), "\n")

# Original rows in BTR (excluding NAs)
btr_included <- base %>%
  filter(Element == "Action") %>%
  filter(!is.na(ActionType) & ActionType != "NA") %>%
  nrow()

cat("BTR rows included (before splitting):", btr_included, "\n")
cat("BTR total Action rows:", 229, "\n")

#####Plot action 
# ---- CDP Action data ----
actions_cdp <- read_excel("data/CDP_benefits_tagged.xlsx", sheet = "Adaptation action")

cdp_action_df <- actions_cdp %>%
  filter(!is.na(ActionType_Tagg) & 
         ActionType_Tagg != "NA" & 
         ActionType_Tagg != "Not applicable") %>%
  mutate(ActionType_Tagg = strsplit(ActionType_Tagg, ";")) %>%
  unnest(ActionType_Tagg) %>%
  mutate(ActionType_Tagg = str_trim(ActionType_Tagg)) %>%
  filter(ActionType_Tagg != "" & 
         ActionType_Tagg != "NA" & 
         ActionType_Tagg != "Not applicable") %>%
  count(ActionType_Tagg, name = "n") %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  mutate(ActionType_Tagg = reorder(ActionType_Tagg, n))

# ---- BTR Action data ----
btr_action_df <- base %>%
  filter(Element == "Action") %>%
  filter(!is.na(ActionType) & 
         ActionType != "NA") %>%
  mutate(ActionType = strsplit(ActionType, ";")) %>%
  unnest(ActionType) %>%
  mutate(ActionType = str_trim(ActionType),
         # Harmonise capitalisation to match CDP
         ActionType = case_when(
           str_to_lower(ActionType) == "ecosystem based"                    ~ "Ecosystem-based",
           str_to_lower(ActionType) == "social"                             ~ "Social",
           str_to_lower(ActionType) == "institutional"                      ~ "Institutional",
           str_to_lower(ActionType) == "infrastructure/structural / physical" ~ "Structural/Physical",
           TRUE ~ ActionType
         )) %>%
  filter(ActionType != "" & ActionType != "NA") %>%
  count(ActionType, name = "n") %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  mutate(ActionType = reorder(ActionType, n))

action_colours <- c(
  "Ecosystem-based"     = "#4DA04A",
  "Social"              = "#E8A838",
  "Institutional"       = "#F0C93A",
  "Structural/Physical" = "#808080"
)

# ---- Plot CDP ----
p_cdp <- ggplot(cdp_action_df, aes(x = ActionType_Tagg, y = n, fill = ActionType_Tagg)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = -0.2, size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = action_colours) +
  labs(title = "Self-reported city-level data (CDP database)", x = NULL, y = "Data points") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 13),
        axis.text  = element_text(size = 15)) +
  expand_limits(y = max(cdp_action_df$n) * 1.15)

# ---- Plot BTR ----
p_btr <- ggplot(btr_action_df, aes(x = ActionType, y = n, fill = ActionType)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = -0.2, size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = action_colours) +
  labs(title = "Country-reported information in BTRs", x = NULL, y = "Data points") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 13),
        axis.text  = element_text(size = 15)) +
  expand_limits(y = max(btr_action_df$n) * 1.15)

# ---- Panel plot with A/B labels ----
p_panel <- p_cdp + p_btr +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Action Types: CDP vs BTR",
    tag_levels = "A",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
      plot.tag   = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16)
    )
  )

print(p_panel)
ggsave("figures/panel_actiontype.png", p_panel, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300)
